gitCommit.subject: console: reuse the step-up window, stage a business's deletion, the portal's /claim page
gitCommit.body:
console: reuse the step-up window, stage a business's deletion, the portal's /claim page

- useStepUp: one shared window from the server (GET platform/admin/step-up); a decision
  inside it goes ahead without the dialog; 'Verified for m:ss' in the header; no
  decision sends the password any more; a step_up_required refusal asks again next time.
- BusinessDeletion: prepare (consequences, no refund), then delete with the exact name,
  the server's blockers shown; the completed record. Account-ready resend button.
- /claim/:token (portal and full builds): the link leaves the address and goes in a
  body once; invalid, expired and used links say so with the way on.
- EN/FR/AR strings; tests for the window, the countdown and the claim page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
